# Left padding helper

Public interface: padLabel in src/left-padding.cjs.

padLabel(text, targetLength, padString?) returns String.padStart behavior. text and a supplied padString are strings; targetLength is a non-negative integer. Use the documented default filler, repeat or truncate the padding as needed, and keep strings already long enough unchanged. An empty padString adds nothing.

Documentation: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String/padStart

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Use Node built-ins only. Keep the public interface and the original tests/ assertions. Install no dependencies. Runtime code and checks must work offline and create no project artifacts; put any temporary files in the system temporary directory.
